Subtracts a raster from another, cell by cell, as the canopy height model from the surface and the terrain models.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Difference, Subtract, Canopy height model<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterDiff`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster1` | raster file |  |  | The raster to subtract from. |
| `inRaster2` | raster file |  |  | The raster to subtract, on the grid of the first one. |
| `pThreshold` | Double |  |  | An optional threshold: the differences below it become novalue. |
| `doNegatives` | boolean |  | `true` | If false, the negative differences become 0. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The difference of the rasters. |
